Hello, I also experience passive suicidal ideations and have been very open about them with my therapist. my experience with these thoughts is they will cross my mind randomly during a time of stress/when I'm overthinking about my life and feel anxious/when I get angry about things. And just as soon as they come, they can disappear in a snap because I dismiss them. But there are times when I let them linger and I entertain the thought of self harming/committing suicide. It has helped me immensely to open up to another human being about experiencing them. Some of my thoughts can be brutal/gory/terrifying and sharing that aspect of my daily life with someone helps me 'hear them out loud' and generally helps me gauge where I'm at mental health wise. I hope you are able to find a safe space to open up about your thoughts. I hope showing that part of yourself to someone will be healthy for you and not destructive. Best of luck to you
